Gate verdicts, read off the check-runs: every required context is `success` (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI and its 16 shards, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI); Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Validate Package Dependencies, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Auto Label `success`; the rest skipped by the selector; zero failures. The PR is a draft by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay), head repo = base repo, no governed path; over 3,000 changed lines, so it lands only by an authorized approval after the seat's ACCEPT (AGENTS.md §7 (c)); this record does not change that.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `@object-ui/types` entry gains `UploadResult`, `UploadOptions`, `UploadAdapter` (`src/upload.ts`, type-only, byte-equal in shape to the three interfaces leaving `providers/src/UploadProvider.tsx`). Public-surface widening. Right: the package keeps "zero deps, no React" (the file imports nothing; `File | Blob` comes from the `DOM` lib already in its tsconfig), and it is the one place both `fields` and `data-objectstack` can read without depending on each other, as `DataSource` already shows.
2. `@object-ui/fields` entry gains `UploadProvider`, `useUpload`, `UploadProviderProps` and re-exports the three contract types from `@object-ui/types`. Widening. Right: one declaration re-exported, not a second copy; the only `UploadProvider` export in the tree (grep over `ui/packages` and `ui/apps` at the head); the three widgets read it relatively through `./UploadProvider.js` with the `.js` extension the package's `nodenext` tsconfig demands.
3. `@object-ui/data-objectstack` entry gains `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` and `ObjectStackUploadAdapterOptions` (`src/upload-adapter.ts`). Widening. Right home (ui/AGENTS.md §3: fetch logic against the server lives in `data-*`); the body is the original three-step presign, PUT, complete flow with `uploadWithProgress` and `xhrUpload` unchanged apart from two comment lines, `scope` still typed `API.UploadScope`, and the objectui#12055 request-body pin moved with it into the package's test program (`tsconfig.json` includes `src/**/*`, `type-check` is `tsc --noEmit`; `build` is tsup from `index.ts`, so the test does not ship).
4. `@object-ui/providers` leaves the workspace, the changeset fixed group, the manifests of console, app-shell and fields, five alias tables, two gate fixtures, the CONTRIBUTING row and the lockfile (deletions only). Public-surface narrowing: a published package stops at 18.3.0. Right under the card's recommendation and the maintainer's filing word; the whole-package ADR-0087 operand `@object-ui/providers#*` is the D9 spelling the plugin-ai precedent landed, and Check Changeset is green on it.
5. `createS3Adapter`, `createAzureBlobAdapter`, `S3AdapterOptions`, `AzureBlobAdapterOptions` retire with no replacement. Narrowing. Right under the card's zero-consumer rule as the claim allowed it: 0 consumers in this tree, 0 in hotcrm `6961ab1` with a hitting control; npm dependents not measured, which the card body itself records; the changeset carries the FROM → TO line (an object with `name` and `upload` against `@object-ui/types`' `UploadAdapter`).
6. `createObjectUrlAdapter` becomes module-private in `fields/src/widgets/UploadProvider.tsx`. Narrowing. Right: on `main` it was documented as a no-crash default and not an upload destination, and the widgets refuse its result (objectui#7699), so no consumer could use it as a capability.
7. Behaviour of `UploadProvider` / `useUpload`: the context, the `adapterRef` + effect, the memoised value and the no-provider fallback are the same code. No accept-set change. One consequence judged right: a host that mocked the old package's `useUpload` to reach the widgets must now mount the real `UploadProvider` (the widgets import the module relatively, so a mock of the `@object-ui/fields` barrel never reaches them); the `WizardForm.nextMidUpload` test shows the shape, and the context, not the barrel, was always the contract.
8. Importers re-pointed with their dependencies declared: console `App.tsx` and `ProfilePage.tsx` (console manifest carries `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/fields`), app-shell `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx` and `SettingsPage.tsx` (app-shell manifest carries both), plugin-form's test (`@object-ui/fields` declared). No undeclared import, no cycle: `fields` depends on `types`; `data-objectstack` on `types`, `core`, `client`; neither on the other.
9. `check-doc-links` decidable floor 126 → 125 with the measurement in its comment (the retired README's 2 decidable, 0 site-absolute links). Right, by the `c59b1bfa` precedent; the site-absolute floor stays at 39.
10. `workspace-vite` alias pin (five → four) and the `side-effects` fixture lose the entry. Right: the alias table is derived from the dependency scan, and nothing in `ui/packages/cli/src` names the package any more.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/25921-providers-upload-fold.md`: `@object-ui/fields` patch, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` patch, title with `!`, BREAKING paragraph, one FROM line naming the package, the ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired @object-ui/providers#*` disposition, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Level right: nothing an author writes moves, so `none` takes `patch`, and a breaking non-protocol change ships `patch` with its banner and disposition (AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3). Disposition right: a deleted package cannot be named in frontmatter, so bumping the two receivers is the only landable shape.
- `.changeset/25921-upload-adapter-contract.md`: `@object-ui/types` patch, `yes (widening)`, `none`. Right: a pure type widening, `none` kind.
- The direction arm on the fold changeset and on the PR body reads `yes (widening)`. WRONG, must-fix. `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` fixes the closed set: `yes (widening)` is "a widening, said out loud", and the spelling for "a diff that widens one surface and narrows another" is `yes (narrowing)`, where "both facts are true and both are read". This diff retires a published package, three exported factories and two option types (①4–6): the breaking narrowing is a fact the arm exists to carry, and `(widening)` leaves it undeclared in the one machine-read place. Consequences measured in the tree: `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` `owedFace` routes a `yes` body without the `(narrowing)` arm to the `declaration` limb at `TIER_DEFAULT`, not to `narrowing`, so the review this record renders is owed by a face the PR's own declaration denies; `record-recognisers --template --paths` over this file list refuses to derive the face and says the changeset's arm decides it; the clause2-line docblock names a narrowing shipping "with every gate green" because breaking-ness was read off a prose banner alone as the defect the arm closes. The card's own precedent treats this class as a FAIL: director record 6585079783 on #29529 failed a wrong arm spelling and amendment 6585097086 corrected it. Remedy: the changeset line becomes `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` (the dev pushes it) and the seat patches the PR body's line to match; `Metadata-protocol: none` and the `patch` levels stay. With the `(narrowing)` arm in place the PR body also owes the third line pm-dispatch SKILL.md names, `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`, rewritten to `#N` once the seat files the governed card (③ below).

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6662170794: `open_questions` is empty; seven deviations and five out-of-scope findings, each answered here.

- Deviation 1 (the doc-links floor outside the claim): stopped, reported, added by amendment 6661629147 before the push. Answered; the floor move is judged right in ①9.
- Deviation 2 (one `!` changeset for the two receivers plus a separate `types` changeset, not one per package touched): answered; this is the only shape a deleted package admits, and the levels are right (②).
- Deviation 3 (two pushes): answered, no bearing.
- Deviation 4 (wrong session id in the first seat message, corrected in amendment 6660272388): answered, no bearing.
- Deviation 5 (`origin/main` five commits ahead, not merged; `merge-tree --write-tree` clean; the one shared file `fields/src/index.tsx` moves in another region): answered; a `main` merge before the queue is the usual pre-landing step, no review bearing.
- Deviation 6 (no assignee, no reviewer): answered; the dispatch forbids both.
- Deviation 7 (Human Minimum item 8 unchecked for the Chinese maintainer block): answered; the block is the dispatch's requirement.
- Out-of-scope 1 (`skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` still tells a reader to install `@object-ui/providers` for uploads, two lines): escalated. The skill ships in `@objectstack/skills` and is governed (Tier H), so it is a separate card, as the plugin-ai batch did with #27048. The seat files it before ACCEPT and names it on the PR body's `Skills-docs:` line (②). Should-fix, carried in ④.
- Out-of-scope 2 (`ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` historical sentence): answered; it goes on the same governed follow-up.
- Out-of-scope 3 (`content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx` names the trio): answered; release text, never edited in a code PR.
- Out-of-scope 4 (the retired README held the only `UploadProvider` usage guide; `fields/README.md` names the pipeline without an import line): escalated as should-fix in ④.
- Out-of-scope 5 (`ui/.changeset/` pre-merge notes naming the package): answered; the root config does not read that directory (ui/AGENTS.md §9).
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; no non-relay login to name.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing, read against the published spec on `origin/main` (`ui/packages/providers/README.md` and `src/index.ts`): the capability the spec declares to a consumer is one ambient upload context the file, image and avatar widgets upload through, filled by the ObjectStack three-step adapter or any object with `name` and `upload`. After this PR that capability is delivered whole from `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, with the contract in `@object-ui/types`: nothing is narrowed at a consumer, and no declared-but-undelivered capability is papered over. The two cloud-bucket factories were declared and delivered; the PR retires them as a published capability with zero measured consumers and a migration line, which is the retirement arm of the rule, not a consumer-side narrowing. Attempts to break it: a host on `@object-ui/providers@18.3.0` beside the new `fields` mounts a different React context, so its adapter would be invisible to the widgets, and the changeset's instruction to drop the dependency and import from `fields` is exactly the fix; the dependency graph has no cycle (①8); `fields`' `sideEffects: false` holds (a module-level `createContext` is pure); `UploadOptions.path` now documents an adapter that no in-tree factory reads, harmless since host adapters may; the `createObjectUrlAdapter()` mentions left in console `App.tsx`, `AppContent.tsx` and the 10131 test name a now module-private function by symbol, which still reads true. Nothing here breaks.

Findings:
- Must-fix (the ② arm): the diff's narrowing is undeclared in the machine-read direction arm; `yes (widening)` on the fold changeset and the PR body becomes `yes (narrowing)`, and the PR body gains the `Skills-docs:` line. A FAIL until the arm is corrected on a new head; a delta re-review of that head suffices.
- Should-fix (docs, ui/AGENTS.md #2): the PR deletes the only `UploadProvider` wiring guide and adds none. `ui/packages/fields/README.md` should carry the usage block (import `UploadProvider` from `@object-ui/fields`, the adapter from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, the no-provider fallback refuses every pick), and `ui/packages/data-objectstack/README.md` should name `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` and its `scope` option; otherwise a docs follow-up card named on the PR before landing.
- Should-fix (governed follow-up): `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` lines teaching `@object-ui/providers` for uploads, plus the `ui/.claude` console guide sentence, go on one Tier H card the seat files before ACCEPT, named on the `Skills-docs:` line.

### ① Derived judgments

Unchanged from 6662493953, items 1–10, all judged right: the three widenings (`@object-ui/types` gains the three contract types; `@object-ui/fields` gains `UploadProvider`, `useUpload`, `UploadProviderProps` and re-exports the types; `@object-ui/data-objectstack` gains `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` and its options), the narrowings (`@object-ui/providers` retired at 18.3.0 with the D9 whole-package operand; `createS3Adapter`, `createAzureBlobAdapter` and their option types retired at zero measured consumers with a FROM → TO line; `createObjectUrlAdapter` module-private), the unchanged behaviour of the context and the adapter, the declared dependencies with no cycle, the doc-links floor and the two fixtures. The delta adds no accept-set or public-surface change: a changeset body line and two README sections publish nothing a compiler or a runtime reads.

Delta judgments on what the READMEs now claim, read against the code at the head: `fields/README.md` says the widgets upload through the nearest `UploadProvider`'s adapter read by `useUpload()`, that any object with `name` and `upload(file, options)` typed by `UploadAdapter` from `@object-ui/types` is a destination (the package re-exports the three types), and that with no provider the hook falls back to a local `blob:` adapter whose result the widgets refuse because it carries no `sys_file` id, surfacing an "upload did not complete" error and storing nothing.
